question: Chords AB and CD of a circle, when produced, meet at the point P. If AB = 6.3 cm, BP = 4.5 cm, and CD = 3.6 cm, then the length (in cm) of PD is
solution:
**Given:**

AB = 6.3 cm, BP = 4.5 cm, and CD = 3.6 cm

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3308d3601963becfc2c606305478c2ffae3f372c2fddcaa062b6098c6e02d87.png] 

Let, PD = x cm

We know, PB × PA = PD × PC

⇒ PB × (PB + BA) = PD × (PD + DC)

⇒ 4.5 × (4.5 + 6.3) = x × (x + 3.6)

⇒ 4.5 × 10.8 = x² + 3.6x

⇒ 48.6 = x2 + 3.6x

⇒ 10x2 + 36x - 486 = 0

⇒ 5x2 + 18x - 243 = 0

⇒ x = {-18 pm sqrt{18²-4times 5 times (-243)} over 2 times 5}

⇒ x = (-18±72)/(10)

⇒ x = (-18 + 72)/10 = 54/10 = 5.4

⇒ x = (-18 - 72)/10 = - 90/10 = - 9 [Not possible]

**∴ The length (in cm) of PD is 5.4 cm**
